entities.name: Svatopluk, Duke of Bohemia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Svatopluk was Duke of Bohemia from 1107 until his assassination in 1109. His rule was overshadowed by the fierce conflict around the Bohemian throne in the 12th century.
